positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: When intelligence is owned versus rented, where does the durable asset actually sit — in the substrate or in the perspective?
positions.why: src-2 draws the owned/rented distinction directly; src-3 restates it in commodity/asset terms, locating the kept value in 'perspective' rather than 'substrate'. Both read in the same direction: the thing that matters is not the interchangeable base layer but the perspective built on it. Grouping them names that shared directional stance without adjudicating it further.
positions.why_no_under: no strata or narrative leaves are supplied yet in this fresh space
